title: A Reproducibility Protocol for Cross-Implementation Evaluation of Post-Quantum ACVP Test Vectors
abstract: arXiv:2608.13784v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Independent implementations of a cryptographic standard should reproduce the same known-answer results, yet agreement is meaningful only when the corpus, revisions, public interfaces, exclusions, and evidence are precisely stated. This study defines a product-neutral reproducibility protocol for three public implementations of NIST ML-KEM against a pinned public Automated Cryptographic Validation Protocol corpus. Protocol v2 freezes provider-specific capabilities, applies one validation-error taxonomy symmetrically, preserves every selected case, and separates bytes, validation verdicts, unsupported operations, and adapter errors. The source-built experiment evaluated @noble/post-quantum 0.7.0, liboqs 0.16.0, and Go 1.26.4. translated_title: 跨实现评估后量子ACVP测试向量的可复现性协议
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13784v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：密码学标准的独立实现应重现相同的已知答案结果，但只有在语料库、修订版本、公共接口、排除项和证据被精确说明时，一致性才有意义。本研究针对NIST ML-KEM的三个公共实现，定义了一个产品中性的可复现性协议，基于固定的公共自动化密码验证协议语料库。协议v2冻结了供应商特定能力，对称应用一种验证错误分类法，保留每个选定的案例，并分离字节、验证裁决、不支持的操作和适配器错误。基于源代码构建的实验评估了@noble/post-quantum 0.7.0、liboqs 0.16.0和Go 1.26.4。在三次重复中，所需的笛卡尔积包含2,160条基础记录：所有1,650条声明可执行的评估与NIST预言机匹配，所有510条不支持的记录与Go的预声明能力匹配。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种产品中性的可复现性协议，通过固定语料库和对称验证错误分类法，成功验证了三个后量子ML-KEM实现与NIST测试向量的一致性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a product-neutral reproducibility protocol that, by pinning the corpus and applying a symmetric validation-error taxonomy, successfully verifies consistency across three post-quantum ML-KEM implementations with NIST test vectors.
